proposal.summary: Gitpod versions prior to release-2022.11.2.16 have a Cross-Site WebSocket Hijacking (CSWSH) vulnerability: the Origin header is not restricted, allowing attackers to make WebSocket connections to the Gitpod JSONRPC server using a victim's credentials, which can lead to data extraction or full workspace takeover.

proposal.recommended_next_step: Verify the affected Gitpod deployment and reproduce by attempting cross-origin WebSocket connections to the JSONRPC server; confirm Origin header handling and determine whether authentication is bound to origin. If confirmed, apply update to release-2022.11.2.16 or implement Origin validation and revoke compromised sessions.
